requirements_summary: Scale: support 200M vectors with incremental upserts (~10k/day).
Latency: retrieval+rerank 95th pctl <= 200ms (goal 120ms) for 1-2 sentence queries.
Throughput: sustained 100-120 QPS with brief spikes to 300 QPS during peak ingestion windows.
Accuracy: reranker must improve MRR by >12% vs baseline ANN-only pipeline.
Cost: goal $0.002 - $0.01 per query depending on rerank depth (budget-constrained).
Operational: ability to snapshot and restore index; incremental rebuilds; metrics for token/compute cost per route.
connector_requirements: Native pgvector connector for on-prem Postgres clusters (TLS + mutual auth).
Elastic-compatible pipeline: dual-write metadata to Elastic + vectors to vector store; low-latency sync (sub-second eventual consistency).
Ability to plug Pinecone or managed vectordb in cloud for proof-of-concept; transparent fallback to on-prem variant.
Bulk ingest tool that accepts PDFs, OCR outputs; supports dedupe and text-normalization pre-embedding.
Monitoring hooks: per-upsert latency, queue backpressure alerts, and cold-start metrics for quantized models.
poc_plan: Week 0: environment setup - VPC peering, VPN to their on-prem infra, deploy test pgvector cluster (sample).
Week 1: ingest 5M doc subset, validate embeddings quality (open models + custom fine-tune), evaluate ANN recall.
Week 2: integrate cross-encoder reranker, run A/B vs baseline rerank depth (top-50 -> top-5), measure MRR/Latency.
Week 3: scale test to 25M docs (simulate 200M vectors via sharding + quantization), measure 95th pctl latency at 120 QPS.
Week 4: cost analysis, operational runbook handoff, decision review with Legal/Procurement.
security_review: Requested: SOC2 Type II report, network diagram for Private deployment, KMS integration options.
